text:
maria: rolling up a quick thread for tonight's SDK publish window (01:00 UTC). plan: simultaneous py + ts 1.5.0 canary -> docs + dist-tag.
sam: note, there's an outstanding pipeline image rotation that might affect signature verification. I'm running a dry-run now.
anya: FYI I saw a packaging lint failure earlier in staging for py (extra tests/ dir included). fixed in a quick patch but wanted to flag possibility of repack.
cheng: docs: we'll stage release note saying 'canary under "next"; customers should pin to 1.4.x if they need stability'. also will add the deprecation blurb for sync-client with sunset 2026-07-01 as discussed.
maria: good. policy: never flip 'next' -> 'latest' without 30m of no-errors and a :thumbsup: from me. also we should include rollback commands.
sam: dry-run results: py repack OK. TS dry-run failed at artifact-verify: verifier image 2026-03-01 is old. deploy-bot shows mismatch.
deploy-bot: artifact-verify failed for @redwood/sdk-typescript 1.5.0: sig mismatch (0x4b1e... vs expected 0x8f2a...). pipeline: release-pipeline-9 step artifact-verify.+maria: do NOT publish until artifact-verify passes.
lee: quick proposal — publish Python now, tag TS as 'next' only once we have a verified artifact. that keeps momentum.
maria: agreed. if TS needs repack, we repack and publish under 'next'. set an automated watch for errors for 45m.
sam: investigating verifier image. looks like the new KMS key wasn't present on the older runner image. I'll trigger a pipeline rebuild using the updated runner. ETA 12m.
anya: re: the py extra tests/ dir, I pushed a .npmignore fix and republished the wheel. confirmed wheel hash.
deploy-bot: package-publish: redwood-sdk 1.5.0 (python) published by sam.
cheng: docs updated: release note draft now says: "Python 1.5.0 published; TypeScript 1.5.0 held pending artifact verification. If you depend on legacy sync, pin to @redwood/sdk-sync@0.9.x. See migration guide and pinning instructions."
maria: include explicit rollback snippet for npm & pip: ```npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.4.3 latest && npm unpublish @redwood/sdk-typescript@1.5.0 --force (internal only)``` and for pip remove wheel from our index and re-point clients. keep wording internal.
lee: can we add a short customer-facing status line if TS is delayed > 2h? I'll draft.
sam: rebuild finished — artifact-verify passed locally. repack TS to remove a stray README.tmp (CI worker artifact). publishing with tag 'next' now.
deploy-bot: package-publish event: @redwood/sdk-typescript 1.5.0 published with tag 'next' by sam.
anya: smoke tests: import + basic transform + embed sampling passed in preview. no runtime errors so far.
maria: staging observation window: 30m. if clean, I will authorise dist-tag flip to 'latest' and push final release notes. if issues, we rollback to 1.4.3 and open a postmortem.
cheng: pushing the docs PR and changelog update now.
lee: status page blurb ready: short, factual, no timelines unless we flip.
maria: ok team — watch for alerts and reactions. I'll flip at 02:18 UTC if all green. otherwise we hold and coordinate a rollback. thanks all. :rocket:
sam: ack.
anya: ack.
deploy-bot: dist-tag-flip scheduled at 02:18 UTC (awaiting manual confirmation from maria)
